title: aidd doctor --json
description: What `aidd doctor --json` prints: each check of the repository's wiring, or with `--autopilot` of an autopilot run's settings, and whether any failed.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape. A new key keeps it; a renamed, removed, or retyped key bumps it.

passed.description: True when no check failed: the exit code is 0. A warning never fails.

checks.description: Each check, in the order the text output prints them.

level.description: ok, warn (worth fixing), fail (the exit code is 1), or info (never a finding).

message.description: What the check found, with the next step when it is not ok.

advisor.description: With `--autopilot`: one line about Claude Code's advisor, as information only.

check_yourself.description: With `--autopilot`: what aidd cannot see, for a person to check before a run.
